decisions.decision: Local CLI + desktop window product; no web SaaS stack
decisions.rationale: Genesis is npx argui → form → spawn. PocketBase/auth would be unused architecture.
Folded genesis and repo name; drop clidesk.

decisions.decision: Instant GUI is the v1 hero; project/build are secondary
decisions.rationale: Under-30-seconds goal requires an ephemeral window, not a generated repo as the only mode.

decisions.decision: MVP desktop shell is windowd (or equivalent Node + webview); Neutralino/Tauri later
decisions.rationale: Full Node access in the runner and faster iteration than Tauri for a script wrapper.

decisions.decision: Never rewrite the original script; spawn and stream
decisions.rationale: The CLI remains the source of truth; ArgUI is a wrapper.
alternatives_considered: Transpile or inject GUI code into the script

decisions.decision: Detection is a code-owned schema merged with optional config; no LLM inference
decisions.rationale: CLI metadata is structured; config is the escape hatch for odd scripts.
Genesis calls out .exe; macOS/Linux instant-GUI support is still an open question.

decisions.decision: No LLM, live search, multi-tenant, or document exports in v1
decisions.rationale: Not in the product; prevents Default-A web intake from leaking into scaffold.

decisions.decision: Publish as unscoped npm package argui
decisions.rationale: registry.npmjs.org/argui is 404; npm search has no matches; can-i-publish similarity probe returned available. Real publish later returned 403 similar to arg, args, argv.

decisions.decision: Unscoped npm name is gui4cli; product name ArgUI; argui bin alias
decisions.rationale: argui failed similarity. User published gui4cli@0.0.0 successfully on 2026-08-13.

gotchas.issue: Unscoped argui is 404 on the registry and passed can-i-publish, but npm publish returned 403: too similar to arg, args, argv. Dry-run and the probe both missed this.
gotchas.resolution: Published unscoped gui4cli@0.0.0. Product name ArgUI can stay. Do not trust dry-run or can-i-publish for similarity.
